Ranbir Kapoor Apologizes for Speech Slip in Kolkata

Actor Ranbir Kapoor apologized for a slip of the tongue during a Dussehra speech in Kolkata. He used the phrase 'Barbaad karein alfaaz mere' after an apparent misstatement, later stating, 'Jo Bhi Main Kehna Chahun Barbaad Karde Alfaaz Mere,' which translates to 'May the words I want to say ruin me.'
